curatedMovie.curiosityHook: With a ruthless drug lord demanding repayment, can a cornered pusher find the money before his time runs out completely?
curatedMovie.description: After a botched deal, a drug pusher faces mounting desperation over a large debt to a ruthless drug lord.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, heavy, and relentlessly suspenseful—an intense solo watch steeped in gritty street pressure.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This action-crime drama stays close to a botched deal and the pressure it puts on a pusher in debt.
